summary: Frontend verification of two auth bug fixes: (1) Sign out on Settings now works instantly, (2) legacy email/password login is fast. All targeted flows and regressions pass.

issues: Wrong-password error text shows generic 'Something went wrong.' instead of a more specific 'Invalid email or password' — minor UX polish, not a blocker.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Improve wrong-password error message on Login page to be more specific than 'Something went wrong.'
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.logout() fires api.post('/auth/logout') and supabaseSignOut() as fire-and-forget after clearing local state — correct fix for the hang, but ensure the unawaited promises have .catch() handlers to avoid unhandledrejection warnings in production.

Login.jsx tries legacy endpoint first and falls back to Supabase only on 400/401/404 — sensible; consider also falling back on network errors (0 / TypeError) so a transient legacy-API outage doesn't block Supabase users.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one TEST_reg_1786894287@clanchat.app (handle testreg1786894287) during registration regression — cleanup verified (1 user doc removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding tour (data-testid='onboarding-tour') overlays pages on first login/registration and intercepts pointer events — dismiss via the visible 'Skip' text or the close (X) button before clicking anything else, including logout-btn on /settings. Login submit selector: [data-testid='login-submit']. Preview base URL: https://clan-chat-fix.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: BUG1 root cause: previous logout() awaited two sequential network calls (server /auth/logout + Supabase signOut) before clearing local state — on flaky mobile networks these could hang, making the button appear unresponsive. Fix clears local state synchronously and fires network calls as fire-and-forget. Verified 0.07s logout with token removed and immediate navigation. BUG2 root cause: prior flow attempted Supabase signInWithPassword first for legacy email/password accounts, adding a wasted round-trip that failed before falling back to the legacy endpoint. Fix reverses the order: legacy first, Supabase fallback only on 400/401/404. Verified admin=0.43s, bob=0.38s reaching /feed.
